questions.question: The source presents the royal-book story as an event, but Carroll himself denied it in the Advertisement P.S. to the second and third editions of Symbolic Logic (1896): see the [text of Carroll’s denial](https://schnark.github.io/lewis-carroll/html/symbolic-logic/preface.html) and a [scan of the second edition](https://archive.org/details/symboliclogic00carr). Agree presentation as a legend or anecdote, with the denial noted in both versions. The author’s post remains unchanged pending review; the English version uses the published title Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland.

questions.resolution: The story is presented as an anecdote, with a link and brief note recording Carroll’s own rejection in the second edition of Symbolic Logic.
